thread:
maria: Quick FYI — bringing up the q8-optimized llama-variant on longctx tests. Seeing KV index bleed when we prepend repeated system prompts. Repro below, short logs attached.

jonathan: Can you paste the minimal repro?

maria: repro steps:
```
# seed text: 512 tokens of instruction repeated 4x
POST /v1/generate
model: rlf-llama-q8
context_window: 131072
prefix: [SYSTEM x4]
stream: false
```
Observed: after ~18k tokens the LM output starts to diverge; cache positions in logs show entries at pos 17998 then 18 instead of 18010.

kevin: that sounds like absolute->relative pointer flip at the window boundary. Are you seeing consistent offset (like -256) or varying? :thinking_face: 

maria: pretty consistent: indices reset to low values aligned to the prefix length. Looks tied to repeated splice operations.

ashley: ran a narrowed run with token IDs printed. snippet: 
```
KV_WRITE pos=17995 key_id=0x3f...
KV_READ pos=18  key_id=0x3f...
```
No sign of corruption in values, just wrong pos.

kevin: hmm could be RoPE phase scale mismatch when position > 65536 in our quantization path. The q8 packing uses 16-bit internal pointers and we cast somewhere. I'll grep for any int32->int16 downcast.

jonathan: +1 check the conditioning for rotary scale. We applied a heuristics clamp during quant bringup, maybe it only applied to float kernels not the int8 dequant path.

maria: also note behavior is different if we disable prefix caching — then no drift, but latency jumps. So cache path is the trigger.

kevin: opening quick patch that forces 64-bit pos tracking in the cache layer. If that eliminates repro it's a pointer-type bug not RoPE math.

qa-bot: test run 2026-04-12T15:13:20Z started: longctx-regress-q8 #604.

ashley: I ran with kevin's debug build. After 30k tokens the indices still reset but offset is now +32768 instead of wrapping to low numbers. Looks consistent with sign/bit-truncation.

kevin: ok that confirms integer truncation. I'll add saturated arithmetic and convert the pointer metadata to u64. PR incoming.

maria: strong +1 to avoid any silent casts. For canary we should route only to our dedicated dev pool (no prod hosted traffic).

jonathan: schedule canary please, also add an eval that concatenates many small prefixes to simulate chat replay. We should capture both generated text and KV pos logs for postmortem.

kevin: PR 8274 pushed, includes: u64 pos metadata, additional asserts in kv_write/read, and a small repro harness.

qa-bot: CI: run longctx-regress-q8 #604 -> 7/9 tests passed, 2 flaky tests (investigating).

maria: deployed canary to dedicated-dev-2, traffic = internal only. Initial 10k token run looks clean. No index resets observed.

ashley: running extended 100k token pass overnight, will drop logs here in morning.

jonathan: nice. After we confirm, let's sweep quantization path for other implicit casts (q4, q5). We don't want similar bugs in other packers.

kevin: noted. Also adding a micro-benchmark for mixed prefix lengths to ensure no perf regressions from u64.

maria: thanks team. If ashley's long run stays clean we'll promote patch to staging and kick off a small embedded eval battery. Will update here with results. :thumbsup:
